xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
As on March 31, 2025, there exist the following vacancies:
1. Vacancy of Chairman & Managing Director of the Company;and 2. Vacancy of post of three Independent Directors of the Company.
The administrative authority to appoint Directors on the Board of MIDHANI vest with the President of India acting through Ministry of Defence.
In view of such vacancies, the composition of Board is not in line with provisions of Regulation 17 of SEBI LODR.
Shri Gowri Sankara Rao Naramsetti - Director (Finance) & CFO has been entrusted with additional charge of Chairman & Managing Director of the Company by Ministry of Defence w.e.f. January 1, 2025 till regular encumbent joins the post or untill further orders by Ministry of Defence (whichever is earlier). Hence, we have chosen 'No' regular chairperson.
